functions.name: batch-create-additional-delivery-costs
functions.description: Submit up to 100 additional delivery cost definitions from an external accounting system.

code.description: Unique source expense code within the organization.

createdAt.description: Source creation instant with explicit timezone, or null; precision is preserved.

updatedAt.description: Source update instant with explicit timezone, or null; precision is preserved.

externalId.description: Opaque expense identifier in the source system.

erpData.description: Source-system identity and optional source timestamps.

description.description: Primary expense description as Unicode text.

projectCode.description: Project code, or null; not yet supported for BC365.

generalLedgerAccount.description: General ledger account code, or null.

additionalDescription.description: Secondary description, or null when absent.

FunctionInput_candis_batchcreateaddition.description: Organization and additional delivery cost definitions for one creation submission.

processId.description: Accepted import identifier for inspecting cost-definition processing.

FunctionOutput_candis_batchcreateadditio.description: Import acceptance acknowledgment, not completed creation or individual results.

tags.instructions: Use source expense codes and ERP identifiers. These are reusable cost definitions, not invoice amounts. For existing codes use `batch-update-additional-delivery-costs`. Maximum 100 definitions; inspect `list-import-logs` after submission.

functions.name: batch-create-contacts
functions.description: Submit up to 100 creditor and debtor contacts for creation.

iban.description: SEPA bank account IBAN, or null.

name.description: Contact display name as ordinary Unicode text.

vatId.description: VAT identifier, or null when absent.

taxNumber.description: Tax number, or null when absent.

paymentType.description: Payment type; defaults to SEPA. INTERNATIONAL ignores IBAN and BIC.

paymentConditionName.description: Existing payment-condition name to associate, or null for none.

accountPayableNumber.description: Creditor account number; mutually exclusive with accountReceivableNumber.

accountReceivableNumber.description: Debtor account number; mutually exclusive with accountPayableNumber.

items.description: New contact with exactly one creditor or debtor account number.

accountReceivableNumber.description: Debtor account number; mutually exclusive with accountPayableNumber.

accountPayableNumber.description: Creditor account number; mutually exclusive with accountReceivableNumber.

contacts.description: Contacts to submit together; the native batch maximum is 100.

FunctionInput_candis_batchcreatecontacts.description: Organization and new creditor or debtor contacts to submit in one batch.

processId.description: Accepted import identifier, not a per-contact success result.

FunctionOutput_candis_batchcreatecontact.description: Asynchronous import acknowledgement; inspect import logs for individual outcomes.

tags.instructions: Use for 1–100 new contacts from an accounting system. Use `create-contact` for one contact or `batch-update-contacts` for existing accounts. Save processId and inspect `list-import-logs`; acceptance does not establish any item's success.

functions.name: batch-create-cost-dimensions
functions.description: Submit up to 100 cost centers, cost objects or custom cost dimensions for creation.

code.description: Opaque accounting code of the dimension.

name.description: Dimension display name as ordinary Unicode text.

type.description: Dimension category: cost center, cost object or custom dimension.

items.description: A cost dimension to create.

FunctionInput_candis_batchcreatecostdime.description: One batch of cost dimension creations for a Candis organization.

processId.description: Accepted import request identifier for inspecting item outcomes.

FunctionOutput_candis_batchcreatecostdim.description: Import submission acknowledgement, not individual dimension creation results.

tags.instructions: Use source accounting codes and names. The type distinguishes cost centers, cost objects and custom dimensions. For existing dimensions use `batch-update-cost-dimensions`. Save processId and inspect `list-import-logs`; this call acknowledges submission only.

functions.name: batch-create-payment-conditions
functions.description: Submit up to 100 named payment conditions with due-day offsets and optional discounts.

name.description: Unique payment-condition name within the organization.

dueDays.description: Due-date offset in days; not an instant or calendar date.

discountDays.description: Discount deadline offset in days; required and non-null with a numeric discountPercentage.

discountPercentage.description: Discount in percentage points, for example 2.5 for 2.5%; omit or null for no discount.

items.description: A named payment condition to create with day offsets and an optional discount.

FunctionInput_candis_batchcreatepaymentc.description: Organization and a batch of new named payment conditions.

processId.description: Accepted import request identifier for checking condition outcomes.

FunctionOutput_candis_batchcreatepayment.description: Import acceptance acknowledgement, not individual condition outcomes.

tags.instructions: Use for new payment conditions. Offsets are durations in days, not dates. For existing conditions use `batch-update-payment-conditions`. Supply a discount deadline whenever a discount rate is supplied. Check `list-import-logs` after submission.

functions.name: batch-create-tax-codes
functions.description: Submit up to 100 tax codes and their rates for creation.

taxCode.description: Unique opaque tax code within the organization; retain leading zeros.

taxPercentage.description: Tax rate in percentage points, for example 19 for 19%.

description.description: Tax label as ordinary Unicode text.

items.description: A new tax code, its percentage rate, and its label.

FunctionInput_candis_batchcreatetaxcodes.description: Organization and batch of new tax codes to submit for creation.

processId.description: Accepted import identifier for checking tax-code processing results.

FunctionOutput_candis_batchcreatetaxcode.description: Import acceptance acknowledgement, not individual tax-code creation results.

tags.instructions: Use source tax codes as strings. Rates are percentage points, not fractions. Use `batch-update-tax-codes` for existing codes. Save processId and inspect `list-import-logs` for actual results.

functions.name: batch-import-goods-receipts
functions.description: Submit up to 100 externally sourced goods receipts with gross totals and typed line items. This Candis capability is in beta.

value.description: Exact decimal amount in currency units, without exponent notation.

amount.description: Gross receipt total including VAT, never the net total.

status.description: Source receipt lifecycle state.

createdAt.description: Source creation instant with timezone, or null.

updatedAt.description: Source update instant with timezone, or null.

type.description: Line category; ITEM requires quantity, openQuantity and unitPrice.

status.description: Source line lifecycle state.

quantity.description: Exact decimal quantity; service/expense omission resolves to 1.

netAmount.description: Net currency amount with exactly two decimal places.

taxAmount.description: Tax currency amount with exactly two decimal places.

unitPrice.description: Exact unit price with at most nine decimal places; service/expense omission resolves to netAmount.

lineNumber.description: Source sequence number identifying the receipt line.

description.description: Primary line description as Unicode text.

grossAmount.description: Gross currency amount with exactly two decimal places.

openQuantity.description: Exact remaining quantity; service/expense omission resolves to quantity.

purchaseOrder.description: Associated source purchase-order line, or null.

lineId.description: Source purchase-order line identifier, if known.

lineNumber.description: Source purchase-order line sequence number, if known.

items.description: Typed source goods-receipt line.

lineItems.description: Receipt lines, at most 1,000; empty remains an explicit empty collection.

documentAt.description: Document instant with explicit timezone; source examples use midnight UTC.

contactName.description: Vendor contact name as Unicode text.

receiptNumber.description: Opaque source receipt number, including leading zeros.

vendorReferenceNumber.description: Vendor reference number, or null when absent.

items.description: Externally sourced goods receipt with a gross total and typed lines.

FunctionInput_candis_batchimportgoodsrec.description: Organization and native batch of external goods receipts to import.

processId.description: Accepted import identifier; individual receipt success must be checked separately.

FunctionOutput_candis_batchimportgoodsre.description: Import acceptance identifier, not individual receipt processing outcomes.

tags.instructions: Use source receipt numbers and ERP identities. Totals are gross, including VAT; line monetary decimals must be exact strings. Use `batch-update-goods-receipts` for changes to existing receipts. Maximum 100 receipts and 1,000 lines per receipt. Inspect `list-import-logs` after submission.

functions.name: batch-update-additional-delivery-costs
functions.description: Submit partial allocation, description and archive-state changes for up to 100 additional delivery cost definitions.

code.description: Existing source expense code used to identify the definition.

createdAt.description: Source creation instant with explicit timezone; null requests clearing, omit to preserve.

updatedAt.description: Source update instant with explicit timezone; null requests clearing, omit to preserve.

erpData.description: Required source-system identity with optional source instants.

taxCode.description: New tax code; null requests removal, omit to preserve.

costCenter.description: New dimension 1 code; null requests removal, omit to preserve.

costObject.description: New dimension 2 code; null requests removal, omit to preserve.

isArchived.description: True requests soft archival, false requests active state; omit to preserve.

description.description: New primary description; null requests clearing, omit to preserve.

projectCode.description: New project code; null requests removal; not supported for BC365.

customCostDimension.description: New dimension 3 code; null requests removal, omit to preserve.

generalLedgerAccount.description: New ledger code; null requests removal, omit to preserve.

additionalDescription.description: New secondary description; null requests clearing, omit to preserve.

items.description: An existing delivery-cost definition, source identity, and supplied partial changes.

additionalDeliveryCosts.description: Existing delivery-cost definitions and partial changes, maximum 100.

FunctionInput_candis_batchupdateaddition.description: Organization and up to 100 partial additional delivery cost updates.

processId.description: Accepted import identifier, not per-definition update success.

FunctionOutput_candis_batchupdateadditio.description: Acceptance identifier for the asynchronous import, not individual update results.

functions.name: batch-update-contacts
functions.description: Submit partial changes for up to 100 existing contacts, including archive-state changes.

bic.description: New BIC; null requests clearing, omit to preserve.

iban.description: New IBAN; null requests clearing, omit to preserve.

name.description: New display name; omit to preserve.

vatId.description: New VAT ID; null requests clearing, omit to preserve.

taxNumber.description: New tax number; null requests clearing, omit to preserve.

isArchived.description: True archives, false requests activation; omit to preserve.

paymentType.description: New payment type; omit to preserve. INTERNATIONAL ignores IBAN and BIC.

accountPayableNumber.description: Existing creditor account number; exclusive with receivable number.

paymentConditionName.description: Condition to associate; null requests removal, omit to preserve.

accountReceivableNumber.description: Existing debtor account number; exclusive with payable number.

items.description: An existing contact identified by exactly one account number, with at least one partial change.

contacts.description: Existing contacts and partial changes, maximum 100.

FunctionInput_candis_batchupdatecontacts.description: Organization and ordered batch of partial changes to existing contacts.

processId.description: Accepted import identifier; does not imply any contact was updated.

FunctionOutput_candis_batchupdatecontact.description: Asynchronous batch acceptance; inspect import logs for actual contact outcomes.

tags.instructions: Use for 1–100 existing accounts; use `update-contact` for one. Match creditors by payable number and debtors by receivable number. Changes may overwrite supplied values or deactivate contacts. Save processId and use `list-import-logs` for actual item outcomes.

functions.name: batch-update-cost-dimensions
functions.description: Submit names and activation or archive-state changes for up to 100 existing cost dimensions.

code.description: Existing dimension code within the organization and type.

functions.name: batch-update-general-ledger-accounts

functions.name: update-additional-delivery-cost
functions.description: Submit a description, allocation or archive-state change for one existing additional delivery cost definition.

code.description: Existing source expense code.

erpData.description: Source identity required for the update.

taxCode.description: New tax code; null requests removal, omit to preserve.

costCenter.description: New dimension 1 code; null requests removal, omit to preserve.

costObject.description: New dimension 2 code; null requests removal, omit to preserve.

isArchived.description: True requests soft archival, false requests active state; omit to preserve.

description.description: New primary label; null requests clearing, omission preserves it.

projectCode.description: New project code; null requests removal; unsupported for BC365.

customCostDimension.description: New dimension 3 code; null requests removal, omit to preserve.

generalLedgerAccount.description: New ledger account code; null requests removal, omit to preserve.

additionalDescription.description: New secondary label; null requests clearing, omission preserves it.

FunctionInput_candis_updateadditionaldel.description: An existing additional delivery cost identity and at least one definition change.

processId.description: Import identifier for checking the eventual definition update.

FunctionOutput_candis_updateadditionalde.description: Acceptance identifier for the submitted definition update, not confirmation of completion.

tags.instructions: Use an existing expense code and its source-system identity. Use `batch-update-additional-delivery-costs` for multiple definitions or source timestamp updates. This changes a reusable definition, not an invoice amount. Inspect `list-import-logs` for the result.

functions.name: update-cost-dimension
functions.description: Submit a name or activation-state change for one existing cost dimension.

code.description: Existing dimension's opaque accounting code.

type.description: Category that scopes the dimension code.

name.description: New label; null requests clearing, omit to preserve.

isArchived.description: True deactivates and false activates; omit to preserve.

FunctionInput_candis_updatecostdimension.description: Identify one existing cost dimension and supply a name or activation-state change.

processId.description: Import identifier for inspecting asynchronous changes.

FunctionOutput_candis_updatecostdimensio.description: Acceptance of an asynchronous cost-dimension import, not confirmation that the update succeeded.

tags.instructions: Use the source code and type. Use `batch-update-cost-dimensions` for multiple dimensions. True isArchived deactivates; false activates, without deleting identity. Check `list-import-logs` with the returned processId.

functions.name: update-general-ledger-account
functions.description: Submit a label or archive-state change for one existing general ledger account.

name.description: New label; null requests clearing, omission preserves it.

isArchived.description: True deactivates, false requests active state; omission preserves it.

accountCode.description: Existing ledger account's opaque code; leading zeros are significant.

isArchived.description: True deactivates, false requests active state; omission preserves it.

name.description: New label; null requests clearing, omission preserves it.

FunctionInput_candis_updategeneralledger.description: One existing general ledger account and at least one label or archive-state change.

processId.description: Import identifier for checking the eventual account update.

FunctionOutput_candis_updategeneralledge.description: Acceptance of an asynchronous general ledger account update, not confirmation of completion.

tags.instructions: Use the existing account code from the accounting system. Use `batch-update-general-ledger-accounts` for several accounts. Archiving deactivates the entry without deleting its code. Check `list-import-logs` after submission.

functions.name: update-goods-receipt
functions.description: Submit a lifecycle or vendor-reference change for one existing externally sourced goods receipt.

status.description: New receipt lifecycle state; omission preserves it.

receiptNumber.description: Existing source receipt number, retained as an opaque string.

vendorReferenceNumber.description: New vendor reference; null requests clearing, omission preserves it.

FunctionInput_candis_updategoodsreceipt.description: One existing goods receipt and at least one lifecycle or vendor-reference change.

processId.description: Accepted import identifier for inspecting the eventual receipt result.

FunctionOutput_candis_updategoodsreceipt.description: Import acceptance identifier; acceptance does not establish completion of the receipt update.

tags.instructions: Use the source receipt number. Use `batch-update-goods-receipts` for broader header changes or multiple receipts. Closing changes the source lifecycle state without deleting receipt identity. Inspect `list-import-logs` for actual success.

functions.name: update-invoice-payment
functions.description: Record whether an invoice is paid, with the payment instant when marking it paid. This does not initiate a payment.

invoiceId.description: Candis invoice id from list-invoices; not invoiceNumber.

isPaid.description: Desired recorded paid state; does not execute a bank payment.

paidAt.description: Actual payment instant with explicit timezone; required when isPaid is true and forbidden when false.

FunctionInput_candis_updateinvoicepaymen.description: Invoice identity and the desired recorded payment state.

invoiceId.description: Invoice identifier whose update was acknowledged.

updated.description: Candis acknowledged the update; this is not recipient delivery, a money transfer or a freshly read invoice.

FunctionOutput_candis_updateinvoicepayme.description: Acknowledgement of the invoice payment-state update, not a refreshed invoice.

tags.instructions: Get the Candis invoice ID from `list-invoices`, not its printed invoice number. Marking paid requires the actual payment time. Marking unpaid omits paidAt and requests reversal of the recorded paid state; no money is transferred. Use `list-invoices` to inspect available payment facts after the change.

functions.name: update-payment-condition
functions.description: Submit partial term or activation-state changes for one named payment condition.

name.description: Existing condition's unique name; match key, not a new name.

dueDays.description: New due offset in days; null requests clearing, omit to preserve.

isArchived.description: True deactivates, false activates; omit to preserve.

discountDays.description: Discount offset in days; null requests clearing, numeric value required with numeric discountPercentage.

discountPercentage.description: Discount percentage points; null removes discount, omit to preserve.

FunctionInput_candis_updatepaymentcondit.description: Partial term or activation-state changes for one existing payment condition.

processId.description: Accepted import identifier for inspecting the eventual condition outcome.

FunctionOutput_candis_updatepaymentcondi.description: Acceptance of the asynchronous payment-condition update, not confirmation of modification.

tags.instructions: Use the existing condition name. For several conditions use `batch-update-payment-conditions`. Day offsets are durations. Setting isArchived deactivates or activates the condition without deleting its identity. Inspect `list-import-logs` after submission.

functions.name: update-purchase-order
functions.description: Submit a lifecycle or vendor-reference change for one existing source purchase order.

status.description: New source state; null requests clearing, omit to preserve.

orderNumber.description: Existing source order number, opaque including leading zeros.

vendorReferenceNumber.description: New vendor reference; null requests clearing, omit to preserve.

FunctionInput_candis_updatepurchaseorder.description: One existing source purchase order and at least one lifecycle or vendor-reference change.

processId.description: Accepted import identifier for checking eventual order outcome.

FunctionOutput_candis_updatepurchaseorde.description: Import acceptance only; inspect import logs to determine the eventual order outcome.

tags.instructions: Use the existing source order number. Use `batch-update-purchase-orders` for broader header changes or `batch-upsert-purchase-orders` for complete source orders, including new ones. This updates source lifecycle state, not a payment transaction. Inspect `list-import-logs` after submission.

functions.name: update-tax-code
functions.description: Submit partial changes to one existing tax code's rate, label or archive flag.

taxCode.description: Existing opaque tax code, including any leading zeros.

isArchived.description: True deactivates, false requests active state; omit to preserve.

description.description: New label; null requests clearing, omission preserves it.

taxPercentage.description: New percentage-point rate; null requests clearing, omission preserves it.

FunctionInput_candis_updatetaxcode.description: One existing tax code and at least one change to submit to Candis.

processId.description: Import identifier for inspecting the eventual tax-code result.

FunctionOutput_candis_updatetaxcode.description: Acknowledgement of the submitted tax-code update, not its eventual result.

tags.instructions: Use the existing source tax code. Use `batch-update-tax-codes` for several codes. Rates use percentage points. Changes overwrite supplied values or deactivate the entry, retaining its code. Inspect `list-import-logs` after submission.
